root_cause.text: An incorrect bitmask (`0x7f` instead of `0x7`) is used to extract the IFM region index during the parsing of `NPU_SET_IFM_REGION` commands in `ethosu_gem_cmdstream_copy_and_validate()`, allowing an out-of-bounds index of up to 127 to be stored and subsequently used to write past the bounds of arrays in `struct ethosu_validated_cmdstream_info`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the correction of the mask from `param & 0x7f` to `param & 0x7` under `case NPU_SET_IFM_REGION`. The CVE description explains that `region_size[]` and `output_region[]` in `struct ethosu_validated_cmdstream_info` are sized to `NPU_BASEP_REGION_MAX` (8), and using the `0x7f` mask allows a write up to 1016 bytes past the array bounds.

intent_record.intent_summary: Correct the IFM region mask to restrict the parameter to valid hardware region boundaries.
intent_record.what: The bitmask applied to the IFM region parameter is changed from 0x7f to 0x7.
intent_record.how: This change restricts the allowed region values to a range of 0 to 7, preventing invalid region configurations.
